Name: Resident Evil Expansion

Description:
[size=4][b]We at The Connections would like to unveil our greatest creation:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][i]PERFECT CLONES OF WELL KNOWN ANTI-BOW AGENTS![/i][/b][/size]

[size=4][i]Check our [/i][b][i]Articles [/i][/b][i]for a list of available characters, their drops, a list of characters in the work, and Extra items added (like random herbs spawning as forage).[/i][/size]

[size=4](Some secrets are also in the works, knock yourself out  >:])[/size]
(Eventually, we're gonna add BOWs, once we make the sprites)
